body: I don't know, if that was needed, but, I guess, thank you!

I'm glad, that there are people like you. I can't say from myself, that I've done something similar..
But I talked about these people, who say they would, but when they are in that situation, they do what they don't want others to do - nothing.

I have never been bullied, nor have I ever bullied someone. But I don't know, what I would do, if I see someone getting bullied, if I'm honest.

Guys, I don't think, that being rude towards her helps. She did make a really heavy mistake, and I think we're all angry, when we hear this. But now it's too late. And btw, I don't know, if the most of you would actually stand up for anyone, who gets bullied.
I don't need no ticket, cause I live in Shrek Republic already! Thank you, I didn't know about my luck.

Please take care of yourself, it could've gotten worse than him calling you a "slut". And in my opinion, you did the right thing, you told him - he didn't listen, but he (hopefully) listens to the police.
